idea-plugin.name: Tab Groups
idea-plugin.description:
Save open editor files as named, colored, persistent work groups and restore a coding context when you return to it.

Manage groups from a compact Tool Window, batch-add files from the Project View, and optionally open a matching TortoiseSVN or TortoiseGit commit dialog for a group.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.7 — Refined Header file count

  • Group file counts now use a compact, muted num={count} label, keeping the editable group title visually primary.

0.2.6 — Reliable CI validation

  • Aligned the JUnit Platform test runtime with Rider 2026.2 so GitHub Actions can initialize the IDE test listener reliably.

0.2.5 — Compact Header metadata

  • Fixed Header layout so the title no longer expands across the whole Tool Window and pushes the note away.
  • Group titles and notes now remain adjacent with a compact, stable gap at every Tool Window width.

0.2.4 — Clearer multi-tab identity

  • Redesigned the Tool Window and plugin icons as a three-tab editor surface with one shared group rail.
  • The icon now communicates managed tab groups at compact Tool Window and Plugin Manager sizes, with dedicated light and dark variants.

0.2.3 — Reliable group reordering

  • Fixed Group Header drag reordering in embedded Tool Windows by tracking the pointer directly inside the Tab Groups panel.
  • The blue insertion line and the saved drop position now use the same target Group coordinates, including moves to the end of the list.

0.2.2 — Group ordering and quick add

  • Use Add Open Tabs… on a group Header to select currently open files and add them directly to that group.
  • Drag the new six-dot Header grip to reorder Tab Groups. The insertion line shows whether the group will be placed before or after the target.
  • Refined compact Header spacing between the title and note.

0.2.1 — Compact tab selection

  • Replaced the persistent Open Tabs checklist with Save Selected Tabs, keeping the Tool Window focused on groups.
  • Select open files in a dedicated dialog with active-tab preselection plus Select All and Clear controls.
  • Create a new group or add the selected files to an existing group directly from the selection dialog.
  • Placed group titles and notes side by side in the Header for more compact scanning.

0.2.0 — Tab Group workflows and Tortoise commits

  • Manage named, colored, persistent Tab Groups from the Tab Groups Tool Window.
  • Create groups from all open tabs or selected open tabs, add files from the Project View, and add files directly to a group.
  • Collapse groups, add an optional note, and press F2 on a selected header title or note to edit it inline.
  • Use Focus Group to close only clean, unpinned tabs outside the group; pinned and modified tabs remain protected.
  • Open TortoiseSVN or TortoiseGit Commit from a group header when its files belong to a detected local working copy.
  • Mixed groups keep separate commit entries for distinct Git/SVN working-copy roots, so unrelated repositories are never combined.
